entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I need to arrange a return for a helmet I purchased a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-09B. I ordered it for my son, but it wasn't quite right.
Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about 60 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference thing. The color wasn't what he expected, so it's just been sitting here. The box is still unopened, we never even took it out.
I understand completely. Getting the right gear is important. Let me just confirm our policy.

Alright, I've checked. Since the item was delivered 60 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I'm a long-time customer and I'm going to have to order a different helmet, is there any way you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase to offset the hassle of the return process?

That's a reasonable request. I see here that you are a VIP member with us, and we definitely want to make sure your son gets a helmet he's happy with. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I've just added a 15% discount coupon to your account, which you can use on your next order.
A 15% discount? That's perfect. Thank you, Isaac, you've been very helpful.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
